post.summary: Analyze a Word or XLSX template
post.description: Returns diagnostics, an ordered recursive dependency tree, and source occurrences without JSON input or generation. Invalid nonempty package content returns 200 with valid=false. XLSX source analysis supports nested templates and supported scalar formula references; generation additionally checks matrix cardinalities, ancestor availability and final reference images.

post.description: Inspects the supplied template and returns a deterministic JSON value with ordered advisory warnings. itemsPerCollection defaults to 10 and values defaults to filled; empty retains the applicable structure and uses empty scalar values. post.summary: Generate a Word or XLSX document
post.description: Returns raw DOCX or XLSX bytes by default after one operation. Explicit Accept: multipart/mixed opts into document and diagnostics.json attachments. Wildcards alone never opt in; q=0 excludes multipart. Among explicit supported document types and multipart, higher quality wins and binary wins ties. Other Accept values fall back to binary. Vary: Accept is always set. All generation and diagnostic preparation completes before success publication. XLSX supports static fields, nested vertical groups, multirow blocks and safe scalar formulas over finite A1 operands including supported sheet/name/shared references, with physical PrintArea crop; it requires JSON object data. Recursive horizontal expansion supports branching sibling blocks and multirow headers, with at most one horizontal region per worksheet. Template structure and values are validated before output is produced.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Explicit multipart/mixed opts in to two attachments. Quality zero excludes multipart; higher explicit quality wins, binary wins ties. Wildcards alone and unsupported values retain binary fallback.

template.description: Required nonempty Word or ordinary XLSX template. Actual OOXML content selects the handler; filename and upload MIME are not authoritative.

data.description: Required text field containing one raw JSON value.

culture.description: Optional culture name; invariant when omitted or blank. Accept-Language is ignored.

200.description: Generated document; warnings do not make generation fail. Multipart has two attachments from the same merge, without base64 encoding.

code.description: Optional stable generation warning code; omitted when unset.
